recipe.visualDefinition: A group of six young people in 1970s attire posing on a white wooden fence in a park setting, framed by a weeping willow and a distant hillside, featuring prominent bubble-style typography in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: The group forms a horizontal arc following the line of the fence.
The weeping willow branches frame the subjects from above.
The large typography balances the visual weight of the group on the right.
Earth-toned clothing coordinates with the natural park environment.
coreInvariants: White wooden fence as a central horizontal divider

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mid-ground group portrait occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure standing between seated members on the fence.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large red-outlined text, moves down the willow branches to the group, and follows the fence line across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant is filled with dense willow foliage, providing a textured backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and browns from the park and foliage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White fence and white trousers provide high-value highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm reds and oranges in the clothing and typography outline.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, filmic saturation with a warm, slightly yellow-tinted color cast typical of 1970s print.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and warm primaries

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold rounded sans-serif with interlocking ligatures.
letterConstructionRules: Tight, overlapping kerning where letters share boundaries
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' features a deep, sweeping curve that cradles the subsequent letters.
Ascenders and descenders are shortened to maintain a compact, cloud-like shape.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom wordmark with no secondary text to maintain focus on the image.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar heavy weight and rounded geometry
Period-accurate soft serif with heavy weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a diverse group of six people in 1970s soul-era fashion (afros, patterned shirts, bell bottoms) posing on a white wooden fence in a park. A weeping willow tree hangs over them from the top right. Soft, warm analog film aesthetic with natural lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, custom bubble-style wordmark in the top left corner. The letters should be white with a thick red outline, tightly kerned and interlocking, using a 1970s psychedelic rounded style.

verificationChecks: Is the typography interlocking and bulbous?
Does the clothing reflect 1970s soul culture?
Is the color palette warm and slightly desaturated like vintage film?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Specific color of the text outline
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any existing brand logos in the corners

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color cast
Balanced interaction between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fence line is straight and acts as a compositional anchor.
Check that the afros have natural texture and volume.
Verify the text outline is thick enough to be legible against the foliage.
Confirm the lighting feels like a hazy afternoon in a park.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Group Portrait + White Fence + Weeping Willow + Bubble Typography Overlay
